risks.note: Project execution depends on labour availability, raw material prices, receipt of approvals and regulatory clearances, access to utilities, weather conditions, and absence of litigation contingencies.

The Company's customers could be impacted by a major economic downturn, lowering demand for their projects; the business is cyclic, with pricing mainly driven by demand-supply rather than cost, and real estate projects are capital-intensive requiring long-term commitment of capital.
Interest costs are impacted by market rates; exposure is managed by matching the duration of investments and borrowings.
Acceptable liquidity levels are required to achieve desired financial results; the Company relies on credit facilities with banks and financial institutions to maintain liquidity.
Competitors may bid at dramatically lower cost or with better/latest construction technologies, pressuring the Company to remain the cost and value leader.

Significant changes in raw material costs (e.g. cement, steel, bricks) can impact profitability, and external factors such as fires, extreme weather, natural disasters, water stress, war or pandemic illness could disrupt the supply chain and impact revenue and profit.
risks.risk: Input cost fluctuations and supply chain disruption

risks.note: Fire, flood or natural disaster could cause temporary loss of a construction operation and reconstruction/remediation costs, though the Company notes it is operating on about 19 projects across Gujarat and Rajasthan so other projects could provide support if one is taken out of action.
risks.risk: Loss of a major project site

risks.note: The diverse nature of the Company's business requires adherence to numerous laws and regulations; failure to meet these requirements could lead to legal and financial consequences and reputational damage.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Project execution depends on labour availability, raw material prices, receipt of approvals and regulatory clearances, access to utilities, weather conditions, and absence of litigation contingencies.
- The Company's customers could be impacted by a major economic downturn, lowering demand for their projects; the business is cyclic, with pricing mainly driven by demand-supply rather than cost, and real estate projects are capital-intensive requiring long-term commitment of capital.
- Interest costs are impacted by market rates; exposure is managed by matching the duration of investments and borrowings.
- Acceptable liquidity levels are required to achieve desired financial results; the Company relies on credit facilities with banks and financial institutions to maintain liquidity.
- Competitors may bid at dramatically lower cost or with better/latest construction technologies, pressuring the Company to remain the cost and value leader.
- Significant changes in raw material costs (e.g. cement, steel, bricks) can impact profitability, and external factors such as fires, extreme weather, natural disasters, water stress, war or pandemic illness could disrupt the supply chain and impact revenue and profit.
- Fire, flood or natural disaster could cause temporary loss of a construction operation and reconstruction/remediation costs, though the Company notes it is operating on about 19 projects across Gujarat and Rajasthan so other projects could provide support if one is taken out of action.
- The diverse nature of the Company's business requires adherence to numerous laws and regulations; failure to meet these requirements could lead to legal and financial consequences and reputational damage.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Bridging the spectrum from affordable/budget to premium residential offerings, building on a foundation in affordable housing while expanding into premium segments
- Expanding into emerging real estate segments shaped by urbanization, changing lifestyle preferences and technology integration: co-living spaces, co-working environments, serviced apartments, and shared-use/flexible formats
- Backing technology-driven businesses adjacent to the built environment via investment (VisionX corporate accelerator program, proptech focus)
- Exploring innovative platforms to democratize real estate investment …
